name: Your Turn To Die - An Alternative Draw -
source:
With a simple change, things can be vastly different, such is the case in this story, enter the point of view of Joe Tazuna in his quest to survive this Death Game.

[From [url=https://an-alternative-team.itch.io/yttdaltdraw]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一個小小的變化，就足以讓事情變得天差地別。這個故事正是如此。你將從田綱丈的視角出發，看他如何努力在這場死亡遊戲中活下去。
